profile.headline: Software Engineer @ JPMorgan Chase & Co. | Payments Infrastructure | Java, Kafka, Kubernetes
profile.summary:
I'm a backend software engineer with two years of experience building financial messaging infrastructure at JPMorgan.

I work on Java and Spring Boot microservices that process SWIFT and ISO 20022 messages using Kafka and Kubernetes. The platform supports approximately 5.2 million messages per month and 46 million account statements per year, so reliability matters. When financial systems fail, the downstream impact is real.

Building systems through the industry's ISO 20022 migration has made me especially interested in the future of payments infrastructure: real-time payments, settlement, reconciliation, interoperability, and the distributed systems behind them.

Outside of work, it's usually soccer. I'm a big Premier League fan and rarely miss a chance to play or watch.
